integrity: The current primary paper was inspected in full through the construction, the weighted Laurent-tail univalence criterion, the exact curvature evaluation, and the concluding curvature identity. The new parameter interval is derived independently by retaining lambda symbolically and evaluating the real curvature numerator and denominator in exact rational arithmetic. A standalone checker replays the polynomial coefficients, discriminant, source specialization, and interval endpoints.
scientific_limitations: The theorem gives the exact parameter interval detected by the source's fixed test point for the explicit Guo-Hu pair. It does not classify convexity for mixture weights outside that interval and does not make a universal statement for all convex pairs in Sigma.
title: An exact robustness interval for the Pommerenke counterexample
